title: Odile and the Veil
author: Sebastian Galloway
blurb: Sebastian Brightwater, a cartographer of unmapped realms, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the long winter finishes falling.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
